prep.summary: The August 26 sync reveals critical security and resource bottlenecks—specifically outstanding threat modeling and a total lack of security engineering resources through year-end—that block the Apple Messages for Business (AMB) proof of concept. Prioritize asynchronous chat via the mobile app as the immediate strategic alternative to bypass current AMB resource constraints.
